signal: Rasa raised a $30M Series C co-led by StepStone and PayPal Ventures and is scaling its CALM generative conversational AI platform for enterprises

email.body1:
Kevin, saw Rasa close the $30M Series C and push CALM deeper into the enterprise.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market enterprise accounts in play than a North America team can cover before momentum fades, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Rasa off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kevin, quick follow-up for Rasa.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Rasa needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kevin, last bit of proof for Rasa.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Rasa's reply rate likely compares to other Series-C startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kevin, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The fundraise-to-scaling stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise-AI motion? I will tailor it to Rasa either way.
